contract.description: Walk a memory's full replacement lineage before trusting it or writing over it. Use it when a recall or list hit looks stale, when you want to know what a fact replaced or what replaced it, and before a forget or restore so the correction lands on the right generation of the fact. Returns the whole supersede chain - predecessors and successors - ordered oldest to newest, each entry with status, tome, creation and tombstone timestamps, tombstone reason, actor and a 120-character body preview. Read-only and tome-scoped: an id that does not exist in the resolved tome returns found=false with an empty chain, not an error - pass tome to read the lineage in another tome you own. upstream_unavailable means the store is unreachable; the call writes nothing.
contract.name: memory_history
contract.title: Show a memory's replacement history
